name: CSKT Transit

name: Custer County Transit
note: Primary on-demand coverage is a 2-mile radius ('bubble') from downtown Miles City per the operator's own page (https://custercountymt.gov/services/custer-county-transit/); out-of-town trips elsewhere in Custer County are available but require 72-hour advance coordination, and weekly Billings trips are medical/airport-only, so the mapped zone shows the primary radius rather than the full county

name: Dillon City Bus

name: Fallon County Council on Aging Transportation
note: Fallon County service open to all community members; Baker and Plevna are service points

name: Fort Belknap Transit
note: Fort Belknap Indian Reservation (Blaine/Phillips counties, MT); tribal boundary aiannh='Fort Belknap' confirmed correct. CSV pin (48.5310,-108.7773) sits at/near Harlem, which is just NORTH of the Milk River — the reservation's natural north boundary — while the reservation's largest community, Fort Belknap Agency, is immediately south of the river; this places the pin ~3.6km outside the polygon even though the boundary match itself is correct. Likely a CSV geocoding issue (pin should be Fort Belknap Agency, not Harlem), not a spec error — see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fort_Belknap_Agency,_Montana and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fort_Belknap_Indian_Reservation.
